Rust AFL++ overlays are scoped to the parser crates (afl_instrumented_crates) because the summary encoder's random hashing made whole-binary maps unstable. Each verified path parses the two valid controls (a query and a response with compressed CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers) to the hand-written oracle summary, has library source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback that differs between the controls. Two valid controls do not establish EDNS0, DNSSEC, TXT, authority/additional or malformed-input behaviour. Package-level adoption metrics include non-DNS use, and the cell is not a definitive top ten.
